summary: Asks the host to prepare every V shown anywhere, once per distinct request, superseding only its own older request, and follows the work.

faults.when: The host needs WolvenKit to prepare this V; work is suspended until it is set up.
Preparation failed; the V stays as shown, with Try again.
The host doesn't answer; retries with a contact-lost state.

lifetime: Per V shown in a visible view; a newer request for the same V supersedes the older.

x-friction.gap: The preparation runs on the host; the page follows it by polling and re-asks after the host forgets it.
x-friction.closes: Work in another process observed as a process here.
